#version 460
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_vector : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require
layout(local_size_x=1) in; layout(set=0,binding=0,std430) buffer Output { float16_t data[]; };
void main() { coopvecNV<float16_t,4> a=coopvecNV<float16_t,4>(float16_t(1)); coopVecOuterProductAccumulateNV(a,a,data,0u,16u,3,5); }
